purpose: Reusable review rules only; study facts live in evidence_register.json.

guardrails.rule: DO NOT INVENT OR REWRITE STUDY HISTORY

citation_rules: Verify each occurrence; separate metadata, access and support; preserve preprint status and limitations.
provenance_rule: Known assistance records do not classify authorship or predict detector scores.
punctuation_rule: Remove literal comma-before-and/or patterns by grammatical restructuring; protect math, code, exact identifiers, URLs and official titles.
completion_rule: Report only actually executed or inspected work; submission readiness is distinct from review completion.
adapter_status: A JSON manuscript register adapter was executed on this study. No universal conversion adapter is claimed.
